summary: A large cleanup and performance push landed in WebRender: removed legacy brush/gradient code, tightened image sampling and tile invalidation, improved text rendering by snapping glyphs and clips to the device pixel grid, and added richer profiling/telemetry support (Tracy) plus better wrench test support. There are also Metal/ANGLE-specific driver-workaround adjustments, multi-window render-backend pooling, and many correctness fixes for borders, shadows, and clip handling. Together these changes make page rendering more stable and predictable, reduce visual seams and flicker, and _help developers and QA diagnose problems faster_ — resulting in **smoother rendering and fewer visual glitches** for users.
